title_zh: 库克确认国行 Apple 智能本月推出测试版
content_zh:
10 月 15 日，库克在上海探访蓝盒子、接受采访时向爱范儿确认，苹果已获批向中国用户提供首批 Apple 智能核心功能，计划在本月晚些时候的测试版中推出。

首批功能包括实时翻译、照片 App 的消除工具及写作工具，但不包含全新的 Siri AI 助手。

据消息人士透露，阿里千问将作为 AI 能力集成至 Apple智能，为 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 的中国用户带来智能体验。用户无需在应用间切换，即可在 Apple 设备上直接体验千问的文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力。

苹果与阿里巴巴的合作方案此前也已逐步公开：爱范儿独家获悉，合作至少包括将千问能力集成进 Apple 智能，以及双方共同训练面向中国市场的专属模型两种形式。

阿里巴巴此前向爱范儿介绍，千问将为 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 中国用户提供文本与图像理解、内容生成等能力；双方也将围绕本地需求和服务共同优化模型。

🔗 相关阅读：独家｜库克确认苹果国行 AI，10 月底上线测试版！
title_en: Apple Intelligence Beta Set for China Release This Month, Powered by Alibaba's Qwen
content_en:
Tim Cook has confirmed that the first batch of Apple Intelligence features has been approved for Chinese users and will roll out in a beta version later this month. The initial release will include real-time translation, a photo cleanup tool, and writing assistance, though the revamped Siri AI assistant will not be included in this phase.

To deliver AI capabilities across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS in China, Apple is partnering with Alibaba. Alibaba's Qwen AI model will be integrated directly into Apple's ecosystem, enabling text and image understanding as well as content generation without requiring users to switch between applications. The collaboration also involves jointly training custom models tailored specifically to local market needs.

title_zh: DeepSeek 崩了 5 小时后恢复
content_zh:
DeepSeek 10 月 15 日下午发布服务恢复及补偿通知，就当天 8:11 至 13:04 的 API 服务故障致歉，并宣布按用户账号 10 月 8 日至 14 日的实际消耗金额，以赠金形式全额返还。

据第一财经、澎湃新闻报道，赠金将自动到账，后续 API 计费优先从赠金账户扣除，返还额度取决于各账号过去一周的实际调用消费。这项补偿针对 API 消耗，并非面向所有 App 用户发放现金。

官方称，已启动针对服务稳定性的全面排查和整改，将梳理并剥离单点依赖。上午故障期间，对话及两路 API 服务受到影响；9:06 官方表示已定位原因，12:49 更新为已实施修复、正在监控，13:04 确认恢复。
title_en: DeepSeek Restores API After 5-Hour Outage, Promises Full Credit Refunds for Affected Users
content_en:
AI startup DeepSeek has fully restored its API services following a five-hour outage on October 15. The interruption, which lasted from 8:11 AM to 1:04 PM, impacted both conversational services and API calls. Official reports confirm that the root cause was identified and resolved, with normal operations now monitored and stabilized.

To make amends, DeepSeek announced a comprehensive compensation plan. API users will receive a full refund—issued as account credits—equal to their total spend between October 8 and October 14. The credits will automatically apply to future API usage. The company has also initiated a complete review of its infrastructure to eliminate single points of failure and ensure future stability.

title_zh: iPhone Duo 维修价格公布，内屏损坏预估 7998 元
content_zh:
苹果首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo 的维修价格已公布。据界面新闻 10 月 15 日报道及其展示的苹果官网收费表，保外内屏损坏的预估服务费为 7998 元，外屏损坏为 3198 元，电池服务为 1898 元。

在 AppleCare+ 保障下，内屏损坏服务费降至 628 元，外屏损坏为 188 元。iPhone Duo 的 AppleCare+ 计划价格为 2599 元，计划费用与每次维修的服务费分别计算。

苹果支持页说明，设备需要经过检查，才能确定最终服务费；保外预估费用适用于由苹果提供的维修，授权服务商可以自行设定保外收费。界面新闻询问苹果客服后获悉，「其他损坏」可能涉及摄像头、主板等更多部件，实际报价仍由门店工程师评估。

iPhone Duo 将于 10 月 16 日开启预售，10 月 23 日正式发售，提供四种存储容量，以及星光白、夜空色两种配色。
title_en: Apple Discloses iPhone Duo Repair Prices: Inner Screen Fix Estimated at 7,998 Yuan
content_en:
Apple has officially released the out-of-warranty repair costs for its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo. Fixing a damaged inner screen carries an estimated cost of 7,998 RMB (approx. $1,120), while replacing the outer screen is priced at 3,198 RMB. Battery service is set at 1,898 RMB.

For users purchasing AppleCare+—available for 2,599 RMB—repair costs drop significantly to 628 RMB for the inner display and 188 RMB for the outer glass. The iPhone Duo will be open for pre-orders starting October 16, with official sales launching on October 23 across four storage tiers and two color options.

title_zh: 蚂蚁阿福与支付宝 AI 支付入选《时代》年度最佳发明
content_zh:
《时代》周刊 10 月 15 日公布 2026 年度最佳发明榜单，蚂蚁集团旗下健康 AI 应用蚂蚁阿福（AQ）和支付宝 AI 支付分别入选「健康与福祉」及「金融与数字资产」类别。

《时代》对蚂蚁阿福的介绍聚焦医疗服务可及性：用户可上传皮肤问题照片，先由 AI 提供初步判断，再连接医生进行确认或纠正。该应用于 2025 年推出，今年 9 月用户规模超过 1.5 亿。AI 初步判断与后续医生确认，是介绍中明确区分的两个环节。

支付宝 AI 支付则让兼容的智能体、应用和设备在用户授权后完成交易。用户先用自然语言提出需求，智能体检索选项、请用户确认，再执行支付；《时代》称，已有超过 1 亿人使用这项服务，今年 2 月一周内处理的交易超过 1.2 亿笔。

本年度榜单共收录 300 项最佳发明，另设 100 项特别提名，评选考量包括原创性、效能、创新雄心与影响力。
title_en: Ant Group’s AQ Health App and Alipay AI Pay Named to TIME’s Best Inventions
content_en:
Ant Group’s healthcare application AQ and Alipay’s AI-powered payment service have been named to *TIME* magazine’s Best Inventions list, featured in the "Health & Wellness" and "Finance & Digital Assets" categories, respectively.

AQ focuses on improving healthcare accessibility by allowing users to upload photos of skin issues for an initial AI assessment, which is subsequently reviewed and confirmed by a human doctor. Launched in 2025, the application surpassed 150 million users this September.

Meanwhile, Alipay AI Pay enables compatible AI agents, apps, and devices to execute authorized financial transactions. Users state their requests in natural language, after which the agent retrieves options, secures user confirmation, and completes the payment. *TIME* reported that the service has served over 100 million users, processing more than 120 million transactions in a single week this February.

This year's *TIME* list recognized 300 top inventions alongside 100 special mentions, evaluating entries based on originality, effectiveness, ambition, and impact.

title_zh: 《GTA VI》发布发售宣传片，全片由 PS5 录制
content_zh:
Rockstar Games 于 10 月 15 日发布《GTA VI》发售宣传片，约 90 秒的影像再次展示了罪恶都市及 Leonida 州的场景。游戏计划于 11 月 19 日登陆 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S，距离发售还有五周。

据 The Verge 报道，Rockstar 表示新片全部由 PS5 录制；宣传片配乐采用电子音乐组合 Justice 的新曲，该组合也参与游戏原声创作。

故事围绕 Jason 和 Lucia 展开：一次看似轻松的行动失手后，两人卷入遍及 Leonida 州的犯罪阴谋，需要依靠彼此脱身。新片主要呈现角色和氛围，更长的玩法展示已于 8 月公布。距离上一部《GTA》正作推出，已过去 13 年。
title_en: Rockstar Releases GTA VI Launch Trailer Captured Entirely on PS5
content_en:
Rockstar Games has released the official launch trailer for *Grand Theft Auto VI*, offering a fresh 90-second glimpse into Vice City and the surrounding state of Leonida. The highly anticipated game is scheduled to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, just five weeks away.

According to *The Verge*, Rockstar confirmed that the entire trailer was captured directly from a PS5 console. The video features a new track by electronic music duo Justice, who also contributed to the game's official soundtrack.

The storyline follows protagonists Jason and Lucia as they navigate a sprawling criminal conspiracy across Leonida after a seemingly simple job goes awry. While this latest trailer emphasizes character dynamics and atmosphere, a more comprehensive gameplay preview was previously unveiled in August. The release marks the first main entry in the franchise in 13 years.

title_zh: Rivian 计划接入第三方 AI 智能体，刹车与转向不交给 Agent
content_zh:
Rivian 创始人兼 CEO RJ Scaringe 在本周 TechCrunch Disrupt 现场表示，公司计划让汽车运行 Anthropic 等外部公司的 AI 智能体。Rivian 已推出自研车载 AI 助手，第三方接入仍属于下一步规划。

据 TechCrunch 10 月 15 日的现场采访，Rivian 的自研智能体框架会先判断用户意图，再把任务交给车内本地模型或云端模型。现有用途包括调节温度、打开座椅加热和摘要新闻，今年 5 月已能访问 Google Calendar 等外部应用。

Scaringe 举例说，车主今后可以先要求打开座椅通风，再接着聊起前一天在其他设备上讨论过的聚餐计划，让车载助手延续既有对话。这需要与模型公司协作，打通用户上下文。

他同时明确划出安全边界：智能体不能自行决定刹车或转向，车辆级控制不会交给 Agent。Rivian 未给出第三方接入的上线日期，后续将于 12 月举办 AI 与自动驾驶活动。
title_en: Rivian to Support Third-Party AI Agents While Keeping Critical Vehicle Controls Off-Limits
content_en:
Rivian founder and CEO RJ Scaringe announced at TechCrunch Disrupt that the electric vehicle maker plans to integrate third-party AI agents, such as those from Anthropic, into its vehicles. While Rivian already features an in-house voice assistant, integrating third-party models represents the next stage of its software roadmap.

Rivian’s proprietary AI architecture routes requests to either local or cloud-based models depending on user intent. Currently, the system manages tasks like climate adjustments, seat heating, news summaries, and Google Calendar integration. Future updates will allow seamless context sharing across devices, enabling the assistant to follow up on discussions initiated on external hardware.

However, Scaringe established a firm safety boundary: AI agents will not be granted control over critical vehicle operations, such as braking or steering. While Rivian has not provided a specific launch date for third-party integration, the automaker plans to share further updates at an AI and autonomous driving event in December.

title_zh: 字节跳动洽谈采购联发科数据中心定制芯片
content_zh:
据彭博社 10 月 15 日报道，字节跳动正与联发科深入洽谈数据中心芯片供货协议，双方接近达成交易。

知情人士称，联发科拟提供为字节跳动平台定制的专用集成电路（ASIC），用于支撑其数据中心运行，采购数量尚未确定。ASIC 是围绕特定任务或平台设计的芯片，与通用处理器采用不同的设计路线。

路透社随后转述了这项洽谈消息。双方目前仍处于协议磋商阶段。
title_en: ByteDance Nears Deal with MediaTek for Custom Data Center Chips
content_en:
ByteDance is in advanced discussions with MediaTek to secure a supply agreement for custom data center chips, according to a report by Bloomberg on October 15. The two tech firms are reportedly close to finalizing a deal.

Under the proposed agreement, MediaTek will supply application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) designed specifically for ByteDance's platform requirements and data center infrastructure. Unlike standard processors, ASICs are tailored for dedicated workloads to maximize performance and efficiency. While contract terms remain under negotiation, the total purchase volume has not yet been finalized.

title_zh: 沃尔沃扩大与英伟达合作，未来车型将采用新自动驾驶技术栈
content_zh:
沃尔沃汽车 10 月 15 日宣布扩大与英伟达的合作，将自家的车辆安全系统与英伟达 AI、加速计算技术结合，用于下一代车型的辅助与自动驾驶能力。

新的合作覆盖 Hyperion 传感器与计算架构、Halos OS，以及 Alpamayo Stack 驾驶软件。双方希望车辆能处理从高速公路、繁忙城市街道到停车场景的完整行程，并逐步引入驾驶者可移开视线、进一步脱离驾驶任务的能力。

沃尔沃表示，这套技术将首先用于一款下一代车型，属于公司新一轮产品计划。双方合作始于 2017 年；本次公告描述的是未来技术导入，现售车辆并未因此立即获得上述自动驾驶能力。
title_en: Volvo Expands NVIDIA Partnership to Power Next-Gen Autonomous Vehicles
content_en:
Volvo Cars announced an expansion of its partnership with NVIDIA on October 15, aiming to integrate Volvo's proprietary safety systems with NVIDIA's AI and accelerated computing platforms for next-generation vehicle models.

The collaboration covers NVIDIA's Hyperion sensor and compute architecture, Halos OS, and the Alpamayo driving software stack. The integrated system is designed to handle comprehensive driving scenarios—from highways and busy urban streets to parking—with the ultimate goal of enabling hands-free, eyes-off autonomous driving.

First established in 2017, the partnership will see these new technologies introduced in Volvo's upcoming product lineup. Volvo noted that the announcement focuses on future technology integration, meaning current production models will not immediately gain these autonomous capabilities.

title_zh: 台积电第三季度净利润增近七成，2nm 贡献 8% 晶圆收入
content_zh:
10 月 15 日，台积电公布截至 9 月 30 日的第三季度业绩：按 TIFRS 合并口径，营收为 14942.4 亿新台币，同比增长 50.9%；净利润为 7630.6 亿新台币，同比增长 68.7%，环比增长 8.0%。稀释后每股收益为 29.43 新台币。

以美元计，季度营收为 467.2 亿美元，同比增长 41.2%。台积电本季毛利率为 66.4%，营业利润率为 58.7%，净利润率为 51.1%。

制程结构方面，2nm 已占晶圆收入的 8%，3nm、5nm 和 7nm 分别占 33%、28% 和 10%；7nm 及更先进制程合计占 79%。CFO 黄仁昭表示，本季业务受到先进制程强劲需求支撑，第四季度仍将受惠于这股需求，包括 2nm 的快速爬坡。

公司预计第四季度营收为 523 亿美元至 543 亿美元；毛利率为 65% 至 67%，营业利润率为 56.5% 至 58.5%。
title_en: TSMC's Q3 Profit Jumps 68.7% as Advanced Chips Drive Strong Growth
content_en:
TSMC reported strong third-quarter financial results on October 15, buoyed by robust global demand for advanced semiconductor technologies. Consolidated revenue rose 50.9% year-over-year to NT$1.494 trillion ($46.72 billion), while net profit surged 68.7% year-over-year to NT$763.06 billion. The chipmaker achieved a high gross margin of 66.4% for the quarter.

Advanced process technologies continued to drive the majority of TSMC's business, with nodes sized at 7nm and smaller accounting for 79% of total wafer revenue. Specifically, 3nm and 5nm technologies contributed 33% and 28% respectively, while the 2nm process node already accounted for 8% of wafer revenue.

Looking ahead, TSMC expects continued momentum in the fourth quarter, driven by sustained demand and the rapid production ramp-up of its 2nm node. The company projects Q4 revenue to land between $52.3 billion and $54.3 billion, with a gross margin expected between 65% and 67%.

title_zh: Anthropic IPO 估值预期降温，部分投资者讨论 1.5 万亿美元
content_zh:
据路透社 10 月 15 日报道，部分 Anthropic 现有及潜在 IPO 投资者开始讨论约 1.5 万亿美元的估值，低于此前对 11 月发行约 2 万亿美元的预期。消息来自四名知情人士，属于投资者讨论，尚非最终发行定价。

Anthropic 在周三的投资者会议上表示，第三季度营收为 168 亿美元，环比增长 45%，当季按经调整口径实现盈利。第二季度营收为 116 亿美元，较第一季度翻倍以上；部分投资者对最新一季环比增速放缓感到失望。

CEO Dario Amodei 与 CFO Krishna Rao 出席了在旧金山总部举行的会议。路透社称，公司未立即回应置评请求。
title_en: Anthropic’s Valuation Expectations Cool to $1.5 Trillion Ahead of IPO
content_en:
Existing and prospective investors in Anthropic have begun discussing a reduced valuation of approximately $1.5 trillion ahead of its planned initial public offering, according to a Reuters report. The figure reflects a pullback from earlier expectations of a $2 trillion valuation for a November debut.

During a recent investor meeting, Anthropic reported third-quarter revenue of $16.8 billion, representing a 45% quarter-over-quarter increase and achieving profitability on an adjusted basis. While impressive, the sequential growth marked a deceleration from the second quarter—where revenue more than doubled to $11.6 billion—leaving some investors disappointed.

The presentation at the company's San Francisco headquarters was led by Chief Executive Dario Amodei and Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao. Anthropic has not yet officially commented on the valuation discussions.

title_zh: Ramp 获 18.5 亿美元融资，估值升至 600 亿美元
content_zh:
企业费用管理公司 Ramp 于 10 月 15 日宣布完成新一轮融资。据 TechCrunch 报道，本轮规模为 18.5 亿美元，公司估值达到 600 亿美元；距离其 6 月以 440 亿美元估值融资 7.5 亿美元仅过去四个月。

本轮由 Dragoneer、Thrive Capital、Founders Fund、Sands Capital 和 Avenir Growth 共同领投。Ramp 两位联合 CEO 在当天的公开信中披露，公司客户已达 8.5 万家，年化营收超过 20 亿美元，并实现正向现金流。这里的年化营收是按当前业务规模推算的年度水平，并非已披露的全年营收。

Ramp 正从企业卡和报销管理扩展到采购、付款、应收账款与会计自动化。今年推出的 AI 费用管理工具可追踪企业的模型支出，Router 为应用选择模型，Glass 则保存团队做过的自动化、提示词与技能，供同事复用。公司将新资金与业务扩展，放在同一套财务运营平台的增长路径中。
title_en: Fintech Unicorn Ramp Secures $1.85 Billion at $60 Billion Valuation
content_en:
Corporate financial operations platform Ramp has raised $1.85 billion in a new funding round, surging its valuation to $60 billion. The deal comes just four months after the company secured $750 million at a $44 billion valuation.

The round was co-led by Dragoneer, Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Sands Capital, and Avenir Growth. In a joint letter, Ramp's co-CEOs revealed that the company now serves 85,000 corporate clients, has surpassed $2 billion in annualized revenue, and maintains positive cash flow.

Ramp is aggressively expanding beyond expense management into procurement, accounts receivable, and accounting automation. The platform recently introduced suite-wide AI features, including tools to track enterprise AI expenditure, optimize model routing, and enable teams to store and share automated workflows.

title_zh: 💡 特努斯：AI 不会让 iPhone 消失，苹果要做能带来差异的部分
content_zh:
在《时代》周刊 10 月 15 日刊出的专访中，苹果 CEO 约翰·特努斯谈到，超级智能的出现不会令手机突然失去用途。人们仍想与他人交谈、看亲人的照片、拍摄影像，因此他看不到一个不再需要 iPhone 的情景。

对于苹果借助 Google Gemini 技术构建新一代 AI 模型的选择，他认为，公司没有必要自行制造产品里的每一个部分，而应把资源放在能带来差异的环节。他以 Siri AI 为例：在用户许可下，手机中积累的信息可用于办事、学习与查找内容；苹果希望通过设备、系统和个人上下文，让 AI 更实用。

对产品取舍，特努斯还讲到了折叠屏研发。他与同事早在 2011 年便申请相关专利，但不愿采用自己不满意的表面材料。产品设计副总裁 Richard Dinh 回忆，团队曾询问是否接受与竞品相似、尚有缺陷的方案，特努斯鼓励他们继续寻找更合适的材料和制造方式。

苹果全球营销高级副总裁 Greg Joswiak 在同篇采访中补充，公司并非以追逐超级智能的铁杆信徒为主要目标，而是想改善普通人的体验。特努斯则将自己的方法概括为：约束范围，把精力投入最重要的事情。
title_en: Apple Exec John Ternus: AI Won't Replace the iPhone, Differentiation Is Key
content_en:
In an interview with *TIME* magazine, Apple executive John Ternus pushed back against claims that advanced artificial intelligence will render smartphones obsolete. He emphasized that fundamental human needs—such as communicating, taking photos, and viewing memories—ensure the iPhone's enduring relevance.

Regarding Apple's strategic choice to leverage external AI models like Google Gemini, Ternus explained that Apple focuses its resources where it can deliver true differentiation rather than building every component internally. He highlighted how Apple leverages device context and user permissions to make Siri and on-device AI uniquely practical.

Ternus also touched on product discipline, pointing to foldable display development—patented by Apple as early as 2011—where the company refused to release products using compromised materials. Apple's Marketing Chief Greg Joswiak added that the company prioritizes enhancing mainstream user experiences over catering strictly to AI purists.

title_zh: 6999 元起，红魔 12 Pro+ 发布：185Hz 屏下全面屏、RGB 水冷
content_zh:
红魔于 10 月 15 日发布红魔 12 Pro+，搭载第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版与自研红芯 R5 电竞芯片，并更新屏幕、主动散热和游戏系统。新机将于当日 18:00 在官方店铺及授权渠道开售。

12GB + 256GB、16GB + 512GB 和 16GB + 1TB 版本售价分别为 6999 元、7999 元和 8999 元。24GB + 1TB 臻金传奇典藏版还将采用锻造碳散热材料，上市安排后续公布。

同场亮相、售价 6499 元的 Mini LED 显示器具有 5184 个独立分区，支持 5K 180Hz 与 2K 330Hz 双模式，采用全铝机身及透明视窗设计。
title_en: REDMAGIC 12 Pro+ Debuts with 185Hz Under-Display Screen and RGB Liquid Cooling, Starting at 6,999 Yuan
content_en:
REDMAGIC officially launched its latest flagship gaming phone, the REDMAGIC 12 Pro+, on October 15. Powered by the next-gen Snapdragon flagship platform alongside the proprietary Red Core R5 gaming chip, the device delivers comprehensive upgrades across its screen, active liquid cooling, and gaming ecosystem.

Priced from 6,999 yuan for the 12GB + 256GB base model, the lineup scales up to 8,999 yuan for the 16GB + 1TB edition. A special "Golden Legend" collector's edition featuring forged carbon cooling technology will also launch at a later date.

Alongside the phone, REDMAGIC unveiled a 6,499 yuan Mini LED gaming monitor featuring 5,184 local dimming zones, dual-mode switching (5K at 180Hz and 2K at 330Hz), and a premium all-aluminum chassis.

title_zh: 小鹏 MONA L05 开启预售，16.98 万元起
content_zh: 小鹏 MONA L05 于 10 月 15 日开启预售，定位大五座 SUV，提供纯电与超级增程两种动力，计划 10 月 29 日正式上市。
title_en: XPeng Opens Pre-Orders for MONA L05 SUV Starting at 169,800 Yuan
content_en:
XPeng officially opened pre-orders for its MONA L05 SUV on October 15, with prices starting at 169,800 yuan. Positioned as a spacious five-seater, the new model is available in both pure electric (BEV) and super extended-range (EREV) powertrain options.

The vehicle is scheduled for an official market launch on October 29.

title_zh: 亚马逊发布两款 Bee AI 设备，手环 74.99 美元起
content_zh:
亚马逊于 10 月 15 日发布 Bee Frontier 与 Bee Eclipse，用于把日常对话整理成摘要、待办和提醒。Frontier 已开售，售价 74.99 美元；Eclipse 将于稍后上市，起售价 99.99 美元。

Frontier 可戴在手腕或夹在衣物上，配有双麦克风、IP67 防水和 USB-C 接口，续航最长 7 天。Eclipse 则是磁吸在手机背面的卡片式设备，单次充电续航超过 21 天。

基础服务包含对话摘要和 14 天记忆。接入 Alexa+、Amazon.com 及第三方应用、自动建议待办等功能，需要每月 11.99 美元的 Bee Pro 订阅，新用户可试用 30 天。

亚马逊称，音频经实时处理后删除，不保存录音；转写文本加密，用户可删除文本与摘要。两款设备均有麦克风开关和工作指示灯，发起通话录制时会提示先取得参与者同意。
title_en: Amazon Unveils Bee AI Wearables to Summarize Everyday Conversations, Starting at $74.99
content_en:
Amazon introduced two new AI hardware devices on October 15: the Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse. Designed to automatically turn daily conversations into summaries, to-do lists, and reminders, the wearable Frontier is now available for $74.99, while the card-style Eclipse will launch later starting at $99.99.

The Bee Frontier can be worn on the wrist or clipped to clothing, featuring dual microphones, IP67 water resistance, and a 7-day battery life. Meanwhile, the magnetic Bee Eclipse attaches to the back of a smartphone and delivers over 21 days of power on a single charge.

While basic conversation summaries are free, full integration with Alexa+, Amazon services, third-party apps, and smart task suggestions requires a Bee Pro subscription for $11.99 per month. Amazon emphasized user privacy, stating that real-time audio is deleted immediately after processing, and transcripts are fully encrypted.

title_zh: 小米开源 MiDashengLM-Spatial，让模型判断声音方向与运动
content_zh:
小米技术团队 10 月 15 日宣布开源空间音频理解大模型 MiDashengLM-Spatial。模型以 MiDashengLM-7B 为基础，可在理解语音、环境声和音乐内容的同时，判断声源方向、相对位置及运动轨迹。

它采用双分支音频编码器：原有语义分支负责声音内容，新增的轻量空间分支处理双耳信号，并接收语义特征辅助定位。训练空间能力所用的双耳音频约为 1 万小时，小于原有音频基座超过 100 万小时的数据规模。

团队还用「交换左右声道」检查模型是否真正利用了双耳信号：原本来自左侧的声音换到右侧后，答案也应相应改变。小米称，新模型在扩展空间能力的同时，通用音频理解能力与基座基本持平。

模型权重与推理代码以 Apache 2.0 许可证公开，可用于商业集成或学术研究。小米计划将相关能力陆续应用于智能家居、汽车座舱等场景。
title_en: Xiaomi Open-Sources MiDashengLM-Spatial for Advanced Spatial Audio Understanding
content_en:
Xiaomi's technology team has open-sourced **MiDashengLM-Spatial**, a spatial audio understanding model built on top of MiDashengLM-7B. The model can process speech, ambient sounds, and music while simultaneously determining the direction, relative position, and movement trajectory of sound sources.

The architecture features a dual-branch audio encoder. While the original semantic branch handles sound content, a new lightweight spatial branch processes binaural signals using semantic features to aid localization. Xiaomi trained the spatial capabilities on approximately 10,000 hours of binaural audio, a fraction of the base model's 1-million-hour dataset, while maintaining its core general audio understanding performance.

Released under the Apache 2.0 license for both commercial and research use, the model weights and inference code are now publicly available. Xiaomi plans to integrate these spatial audio capabilities into smart home devices and automotive cockpits.

title_zh: Meta 开放 Muse Spark Open 权重，两台 Mac Studio 可本地运行
content_zh:
Meta 于 10 月 15 日发布 Muse Spark Open，并开放模型权重。它采用原生多模态设计，总参数为 8160 亿、激活参数为 420 亿，支持 100 万 token 上下文，主要面向编程、长程智能体任务与多步骤推理。

Meta 与苹果合作优化了 Apple Silicon 上的运行方式。借助新版 MLX，两台各配备 512GB 统一内存的 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 可以容纳完整模型。Meta 展示的本地工作流包括为开源 Mastodon 客户端 Ice Cubes 修改代码、构建应用，以及让模型逐帧检查素材、操作 DaVinci Resolve 完成剪辑。

权重已通过 Hugging Face 等平台提供，模型同时适配 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp 等推理工具。它采用 Muse Model License，商用需遵守该许可的限制。
title_en: Meta Releases Open Weights for Muse Spark Open, Runnable Locally on Mac Studios
content_en:
Meta has officially released the open weights for **Muse Spark Open**, a natively multimodal AI model featuring 816 billion total parameters (42 billion active) and a 1-million-token context window. Designed primarily for coding, complex agentic workflows, and multi-step reasoning, the model is available via platforms like Hugging Face and supports inference frameworks including vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp.

In collaboration with Apple, Meta optimized the model for Apple Silicon using the latest version of MLX. Remarkably, the complete model can run locally on a setup consisting of two M5 Ultra Mac Studios, each configured with 512GB of unified memory. Meta demonstrated practical local workflows, such as modifying code for the open-source Mastodon client Ice Cubes and automating video editing in DaVinci Resolve.

The model weights are distributed under the proprietary Muse Model License, which governs commercial usage.

title_zh: Bluesky 扩展 Attie，用文字生成可分享的小游戏和投票
content_zh:
Bluesky 的 AI 工具 Attie 新增了制作小型社交应用的能力。用户输入提示词后，可生成游戏、投票或仪表盘，并把成果作为独立网站分享。

据 The Verge 记者 Jay Peters 10 月 15 日的报道，他用几分钟生成了一项关于《宝可梦 红／蓝》的投票。Attie 网站还展示了「Flappy Butterfly」小游戏、鼓机、问答和放置点击游戏等示例，每个应用都有独立的 attie.site 链接，并在页面底部标注创作者。

Attie 今年早些时候主要用于通过 AI 创建自定义信息流。Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider 在 TechCrunch Disrupt 采访中把这次扩展称为面向社群的「社交氛围编程」。Peters 体验的应用以轻量互动为主。
title_en: Bluesky Expands AI Tool Attie to Generate Shareable Mini-Games and Polls
content_en:
Bluesky has expanded **Attie**, its built-in AI tool, enabling users to generate lightweight social applications—such as games, polls, and dashboards—using simple text prompts. Each creation can be shared as an independent website under a dedicated `attie.site` link, complete with creator attribution.

Initially launched earlier this year to help users build custom feeds, Attie now supports interactive mini-apps including quizzes, drum machines, and clicker games. In an interview at TechCrunch Disrupt, Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider described this expansion as "social vibe coding" tailored for community engagement.

title_zh: 阶跃开放 Step 5 Preview 权重，同步公开长程 Agent 技术方案
content_zh:
10 月 15 日，阶跃星辰正式开放 Step 5 Preview 的 BF16 和 FP8 模型权重，并同步发布技术博客与配套开发工具。权重已上线 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope，开发者可以自行部署并接入数据、工具与业务系统。

Step 5 Preview 采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量为 6000 亿，每个 token 激活 270 亿参数，支持 100 万 token 上下文，以及文本、视觉输入。模型面向需要多轮推理和工具调用的长程 Agent 任务，可通过 vLLM、SGLang 部署兼容 OpenAI 接口的服务，也支持 Transformers 离线推理。

技术博客介绍，模型采用 92 层「窄而深」架构，为隐式多跳推理提供更深的计算路径；Sparse GQA 将相邻的 8 个 token 合并为索引块，使索引与 top-k 选择开销降至原来的八分之一。这项优化针对长上下文中的注意力索引环节。

训练方面，团队在关键状态和参数上保留 FP32 精度，并采用细粒度梯度裁剪缓解深层训练不稳定；长程强化学习则将上下文压缩纳入策略训练，让模型学习整理任务状态后继续执行。
title_en: StepFun Open-Sources Step 5 Preview Weights and Long-Horizon Agent Solutions
content_en:
StepFun has officially open-sourced the BF16 and FP8 weights for its Step 5 Preview model on Hugging Face and ModelScope, alongside technical blog posts and developer tools. Designed for complex, long-horizon Agent tasks requiring multi-turn reasoning and tool invocation, the model enables developers to deploy and integrate it directly into their workflows.

Step 5 Preview features a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 600 billion total parameters, activating 27 billion parameters per token. It supports up to a 1-million-token context window alongside multimodal text and vision inputs. For deployment, it works seamlessly with vLLM and SGLang for OpenAI API-compatible serving, as well as offline inference via Transformers.

Architecturally, the model utilizes a 92-layer "narrow and deep" structure to provide deeper computational paths for implicit multi-hop reasoning. Its Sparse GQA mechanism merges eight adjacent tokens into index blocks, cutting attention indexing overhead by 87.5%. To maintain training stability, StepFun preserved FP32 precision on critical states combined with fine-grained gradient clipping, while integrating context compression directly into its long-horizon reinforcement learning policy.

title_zh: 蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1-flash，量化部署测试降至 4 卡
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵于 10 月 15 日开源 Ling-3.1-flash，模型权重已在 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 开放下载。它面向办公、软件工程和工具调用等复杂任务，可在自有基础设施中部署。

模型总参数约 5600 亿，每个 token 激活约 250 亿参数，最高支持 100 万 token 上下文。百灵介绍，模型可根据分散资料整理报告，围绕既有代码编写功能，并根据测试反馈继续修改；团队还提供了基于开源编码智能体 Pi 构建的 LingCode 运行框架，用于长时间、多轮工具调用任务，后者尚未开源。

部署方面，百灵对路由专家采用 MXFP4 量化，dense 层保持 block-FP8，将权重占用从约 534GB 降至 292GB。在团队给出的 Hopper GPU 测试配置中，服务部署由 8 卡降至 4 卡；实际卡数仍随上下文长度、并发量和服务配置变化。

官方同时提供长上下文并行推理方案，并加强 JSON Schema 工具调用支持。公开模型仓库列出了 SGLang、vLLM 等部署路径及不同 GPU 配置，供开发者按实际任务验证。
title_en: Ant Bailing Open-Sources Ling-3.1-flash, Halving Hardware Requirements via MXFP4 Quantization
content_en:
Ant Group's Bailing team has open-sourced Ling-3.1-flash, making its weights available on Hugging Face and ModelScope. The model is tailored for complex enterprise workloads, including office productivity, software engineering, and autonomous tool calling on private infrastructure.

Featuring 560 billion total parameters with 25 billion activated per token, Ling-3.1-flash supports context lengths up to 1 million tokens. It excels at consolidating reports from fragmented sources, generating code based on existing repositories, and iteratively fixing bugs from test feedback. The team also showcased LingCode, an execution framework built on the open-source Pi coding agent designed for complex, multi-turn tool execution.

To drastically lower deployment barriers, Bailing applied MXFP4 quantization to routing experts while retaining block-FP8 for dense layers, cutting memory overhead from 534 GB to 292 GB. In benchmark tests on Hopper GPUs, required card counts dropped from eight to four. Additionally, the release provides long-context parallel inference solutions and upgraded JSON Schema support for tool integration.

title_zh: Figma 推出 Specs，把 Markdown、设计稿和智能体放进同一画布
content_zh:
Figma 于 10 月 15 日推出 Specs，将需求说明、设计决策和技术方案放到协作画布上。团队可以把现有 Markdown 文件直接拖入，或让 Figma 智能体协助起草；文档还能嵌入 FigJam 文件、设计画框和画布节点，让文字与对应设计一起更新。

Specs 支持多人协作与评论。Figma 智能体可以在文档中回复评论、提出修改，也能借助连接器补入外部上下文：例如从 GitHub 代码库起草技术方案，或调用 Hex 分析产品数据，将结果留在相关问题旁边。

团队确定方案后，可通过 Figma 的 MCP 服务把 Specs 交给编程智能体，连同 Markdown、设计引用、图表、代码层和 Code Connect 片段一起传递。实现过程中，也能把新决定与图表写回原来的文档。

Specs 从当日起向付费方案开放公测，支持网页、桌面和移动端。在 Figma 或 FigJam 中按 D，或点击工具栏的 Specs 图标即可创建。
title_en: Figma Launches Specs to Unify Markdown, Design Artifacts, and AI Agents on One Canvas
content_en:
Figma has introduced Specs, a new feature designed to bring product requirements, design decisions, and technical architecture onto a single collaborative canvas. Product teams can directly import existing Markdown files or leverage Figma AI agents to draft documentation, which stays dynamically updated alongside embedded FigJam files, design frames, and canvas nodes.

Specs enhances team collaboration with direct AI participation. Figma agents can respond to inline comments, suggest copy edits, and pull contextual information from external tools—such as drafting technical solutions directly from GitHub repositories or embedding product metrics from Hex beside relevant discussion threads.

Once plans are finalized, teams can pass Specs to AI coding agents via Figma’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) service, transferring Markdown documentation, design references, diagrams, code layers, and Code Connect snippets seamlessly. Specs is now available in public beta for paid subscribers across web, desktop, and mobile platforms.

title_zh: 谷歌在 Willow 上验证「魔法态培育」，相关错误降至约四十分之一
content_zh:
谷歌 Quantum AI 团队 10 月 15 日宣布，在 Willow 量子处理器上验证了「魔法态培育」方法。与未经培育的量子态相比，相关错误降至约四十分之一，T 态的逻辑保真度达到 99.99%，研究同日发表于《Science》。

魔法态可用于实现通用量子计算所需的一类操作，但制备高质量魔法态会消耗大量资源，使用后也无法重复利用。新方法像一道筛选工序：将含噪量子态注入芯片的小区域，通过一系列协同测量检查错误，剔除有缺陷的尝试，再培育出低错误状态。

团队还演示了将状态从一种纠错编码转移到另一种编码，以衔接后续计算。谷歌表示，仍需在更大规模上验证；这次结果针对关键量子态的制备与转移，并非整台量子计算机所有任务的错误率均降低 40 倍。
title_en: Google Validates 'Magic State Cultivation' on Willow Quantum Chip, Slashing Errors Fortyfold
content_en:
Google Quantum AI has announced a major breakthrough in quantum computing, publishing a study in *Science* that validates a technique called "magic state cultivation" on its Willow processor. The approach dramatically reduces error rates to roughly one-fortieth (a 40-fold reduction) compared to uncultivated states, achieving a 99.99% logical fidelity for T states.

Magic states are crucial for executing complex universal quantum computing operations, but producing high-quality versions is traditionally resource-intensive and single-use. Google's new method acts like a purification filter: noisy quantum states are injected into a small area of the chip, where fault-detection measurements discard flawed attempts to yield ultra-low-error states. The team also demonstrated transferring these cultivated states between different error-correcting codes to support downstream computations.

Google emphasized that while this achievement represents significant progress in state preparation and transfer, larger-scale validation is still required. The 40-fold error reduction specifically applies to these key quantum states rather than all operations across the entire quantum computer.

title_zh: Ganni 与 lululemon 推出舞蹈联名系列，Jennifer Beals 出镜
content_zh:
Ganni 与 lululemon 于 10 月 15 日推出包含 22 件单品的联名系列，以 20 世纪 80 年代舞蹈电影为设计灵感，将运动面料与 Ganni 的豹纹、荷叶边等元素结合。

据 The Hollywood Reporter 介绍，系列包括重新设计的 Define 夹克、宽松套头衫、桶形长裤、连体衣，以及腿套、披肩式短上衣和发带等配件，使用 lululemon 的 Nulu 与 Softstreme 面料。部分单品通过可调裤脚、宽领口和蓬松下摆，调整练舞与日常穿着之间的轮廓。

两品牌邀请《闪舞》主演 Jennifer Beals 与歌手、舞者 Mette 出演「Joy Is a Power Move」宣传短片，场景设在舞蹈工作室。系列已在双方官网及部分国际门店发售。
title_en: Ganni and lululemon Launch '80s Dance Capsule Featuring 'Flashdance' Star Jennifer Beals
content_en:
Danish fashion brand Ganni and activewear giant lululemon have unveiled a 22-piece collaborative collection inspired by 1980s dance cinema. The lineup merges lululemon's performance fabrics with Ganni's signature design touches, including leopard prints and feminine ruffles.

Crafted from lululemon's lightweight Nulu and Softstreme materials, the capsule reinterprets activewear classics alongside streetwear pieces. Highlights include a redesigned Define Jacket, relaxed pullovers, barrel-leg trousers, and bodysuits, complemented by accessories like leg warmers, shrugs, and headbands. Adjustable hems and dramatic necklines allow wearers to easily transition their silhouette from studio practice to everyday wear.

To mark the launch, the brands released a dance studio-set campaign film titled *Joy Is a Power Move*, starring *Flashdance* icon Jennifer Beals alongside singer and dancer Mette. The collection is now available on both brands' websites and at select global retail locations.

title_zh: 特斯拉儿童平衡车开售，售价 1399 元
content_zh:
特斯拉中国官网商店于 10 月 15 日上午 10:00 开售儿童平衡车，定价 1399 元，面向 2 至 6 岁儿童。据极目新闻向客服了解，产品已开放预订，当前订单预计在 10 月 28 日前发货。

这款车依靠儿童双脚蹬地滑行，没有电机和脚踏。车架采用镁合金，产品净重 5.6kg，座椅可进行 5 档高度调节，适用身高为 85 至 120cm、最低适配腿长为 35cm，建议承重上限为 30kg。

车把内置转向角度限位装置，以减少转向过大带来的翻倒风险。官网要求由成人组装和调整，并在成人监督下、佩戴头盔等防护装备，在平坦防滑的道路上骑行。
title_en: Tesla Releases RMB 1,399 Kids' Balance Bike in China
content_en:
Tesla China has officially launched a kids' balance bike on its webstore, priced at 1,399 RMB for children aged two to six. The non-electric ride-on toy is currently available for pre-order, with deliveries anticipated to begin by late October.

Designed for foot-powered gliding without pedals or a motor, the balance bike features a magnesium alloy frame weighing just 5.6 kg. It comes equipped with a five-position adjustable seat tailored for children between 85 cm and 120 cm tall, supporting a maximum load of 30 kg.

To enhance safety, the handlebars feature a built-in steering angle limiter that helps prevent accidental tip-overs from sharp turns. Tesla advises that the bike requires adult assembly and supervision, recommending that young riders wear protective helmets and ride on smooth, non-slip pavement.

title_zh: 抖音双 11 启动，主打现货并向豆包、红果等多端发券
content_zh:
10 月 15 日，抖音商城双 11 好物节启动，活动持续至 11 月 11 日。平台今年主打现货，不做预售，并在抖音、豆包、红果短剧、今日头条等多个端分批发放消费券。

商品优惠延续「立减折扣」和「一件直降」两种玩法，由商家择一参与、承担商品折扣；平台另行投入全资消费券，消费者可单件购买、免凑单。活动分为 10 月 15 日至 18 日的开门红、11 月 7 日至 11 日的狂欢阶段，中间穿插现货日和品类日。

面向商家，平台提供投放补贴、流量激励及履约支持，并继续扩展 AI 工具：罗盘 AI 问数支持对话查询经营指标、分析异常信号，飞鸽智能客服在大促期间限时免费开放，支持全天接待。官方中小商家政策适用于正常经营的抖店，排除即时零售、团购配送和全球购等业务。
title_en: Douyin Kicks Off Double 11 Festival with In-Stock Goods and AI Merchant Tools
content_en:
Douyin Mall officially launched its annual Double 11 Shopping Festival on October 15, running through November 11. Shifting away from pre-sales, this year’s event focuses entirely on ready-to-ship inventory, accompanied by platform-funded vouchers distributed across Douyin and affiliated apps like Doubao, Hongguo Short Drama, and Jinri Toutiao.

To simplify shopping, discounts feature direct price cuts without requiring minimum spending thresholds across multiple items. Meanwhile, sellers receive traffic incentives, fulfillment support, and access to enhanced AI tools—such as Compass AI for real-time operational analytics and free 24/7 automated customer service through Feige.

title_zh: 《The Lowdown》第二季开播，Ethan Hawke 的记者迎来新案
content_zh:
美国时间 10 月 14 日，《The Lowdown》第二季在 FX 和 Hulu 开播，首播两集。Ethan Hawke 继续饰演俄克拉何马州塔尔萨的记者 Lee Raybon，Tommy Lee Jones 和 Betty Gilpin 加入本季。

新一季中，Lee 因上一季的调查报道获奖，却在领奖时发表了一段失控的演说。公设辩护人 Ginger 将他带向一宗新谜案：一名仍在服刑的前客户失去了踪迹。与此同时，与 Lee 疏远的父亲突然到访，开始接近自己从未见过的孙女，让调查之外的家庭关系也变得复杂。

该剧由 Sterlin Harjo 创作，他执导了本季前两集，并编写首集。在《好莱坞报道者》的主创采访中，Harjo 表示，第一季需要建立人物和世界，第二季则有更多空间直接进入 Lee 的生活，也更能展开黑色幽默。Hawke 与 Jones 的父子对手戏，以及 Gilpin 饰演的紧张而能干的辩护人，构成了本季开篇的新关系。
title_en: Season 2 of *The Lowdown* Premieres as Ethan Hawke Tackles a New Mystery
content_en:
Season two of *The Lowdown* premiered on FX and Hulu on October 14 with a two-episode debut. Ethan Hawke reprises his role as Tulsa investigative journalist Lee Raybon, alongside new cast members Tommy Lee Jones and Betty Gilpin.

The new season kicks off with Lee accepting an award for his previous exposé, only to deliver an unhinged acceptance speech. Public defender Ginger (Gilpin) draws him into a fresh mystery involving a missing inmate, while the unexpected arrival of Lee’s estranged father (Jones) adds complex family dynamics to his already chaotic life.

Created by Sterlin Harjo, the second season delves deeper into Lee's personal life with a sharp focus on dark humor and dynamic character relationships.

title_zh: 绿泡泡下架《好一个乖乖女》？抖音集团、出品方回应
content_zh:
据新京报贝壳财经 10 月 15 日报道，记者在微信小程序「绿泡泡短剧」检索《好一个乖乖女》时，仍能看到搜索结果，但点击后页面显示「本剧已下架」。

抖音集团短剧版权中心相关负责人向记者表示，该剧是其全版权独家剧，目前仍在独家期限内，尚未授权给其他独立短剧平台。出品方于今无量 CEO 李峻丞也确认，竖屏版最初在红果独家上线，至今仍是如此。

《好一个乖乖女》于 2025 年初上线红果，共 88 集，由柯淳、余茵主演。红果数据显示，该剧上线一个月播放量突破 30 亿，并于今年 7 月 9 日达到 50 亿播放量。
title_en: Hit Short Drama Removed from External Platform Over Exclusive Douyin Rights
content_en:
Popular vertical short drama *What a Good Girl* was recently taken down from the third-party WeChat mini-program "Lv Paopao." In response, Douyin Group’s short drama copyright department clarified that the series remains exclusively licensed to Douyin's Hongguo platform and has not been authorized for outside distribution.

The show's producer confirmed its exclusive agreement with Hongguo. Premiering in early 2025 and spanning 88 episodes, the series became a massive hit, surpassing 3 billion views within its first month and reaching over 5 billion views by July.
